h1_hero.description: Used for massive SLA numbers or primary dashboard greetings.

table_header.description: Strictly for column headers and micro-labels.

background.description: Warm off-white, editorial feel. Never use pure white for the main body.

surface.description: Flat white for cards. No transparency, no glassmorphism.

text.description: Near-black for extreme contrast, greys for metadata.

brand.description: Core brand color. Used for progress bars, active states, and heatmaps.

accent.description: Electric lime. HIGHLY RESTRICTED. Use ONLY for urgent SLA breaches, 'Due Now' indicators, and primary 'Wow' moment calls-to-action.

status.description: Use sparingly. Prefer brand olive and accent lime for the UI language.

visual_enhancers.textures: None. Keep surfaces perfectly flat and matte to maintain the editorial print aesthetic.

pill_button.css: background: #111; color: #FFF; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Manrope'; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;

table_header_cell.css: text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #666; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(17,17,17,0.1); padding-bottom: 0.75rem;

metric_block.structure: Top: Lightweight uppercase label. Bottom: Massive ultra-light number (e.g., font-weight: 300; font-size: 3rem).

bde_presales_dashboard.name: The Focus Stream
bde_presales_dashboard.left_column: Daily Stats (Cards: Calls Due, Contacted Today, Conversions).
bde_presales_dashboard.center_column: The 'Due Now' Work Stack. Not a table. A vertical feed of tasks sorted strictly by time-to-breach.
bde_presales_dashboard.right_column: Context Panel. Loads dynamically based on the active lead in the center column. Shows score, source, and 1-tap collateral buttons.
bde_presales_dashboard.wow_factor: The 'Active Lead' focus card. The top lead in the center column expands automatically into a large, prominent card. It features a massive ticking SLA timer in Electric Lime, a bold lead name, and three massive black pill buttons for 1-tap disposition (Contacted, No Response, Invalid) that trigger a smooth slide-away animation upon click.

bdm_sales_dashboard.name: The Opportunity Canvas
bdm_sales_dashboard.top_row: Today's Agenda. A horizontally scrolling flex row of 'Confirmed Booking / Meet' cards. High contrast (Black cards with white text) to differentiate from the pipeline.
bdm_sales_dashboard.wow_factor: The 'Pipeline Pulse'. Since 13 stages are too wide for a standard view, build a horizontally scrolling canvas using CSS scroll-snap. The cards inside the pipeline are NOT generic boxes; they are dense, flat strips. Each strip features an 'Aging Line' at the bottom (a border-bottom that changes from Olive to Lime to Red as the lead ages in that stage without movement) and a pulsing dot if the WhatsApp engagement loop is currently active.

admin_dashboard.name: The Command Matrix
admin_dashboard.structure: Bento Grid Layout (CSS Grid: auto-rows: minmax(200px, auto); gap: 24px;)
admin_dashboard.top_half: Left: Conversion Funnel. Right: Workload Balance (BDE vs BDM).
admin_dashboard.wow_factor: The 'Gravity Heatmap'. A pure CSS Grid matrix displaying the 13 pipeline stages (Y-axis) against aging days (X-axis). The cells use dynamic background colors mapped to the Olive brand color scale (e.g., #E9EDD9 for low volume, #4F5823 for high volume). Hovering over a cell dims the rest of the board (using CSS :has() or vanilla JS) to instantly highlight exactly where deals are getting stuck.

motion.philosophy: Editorial and snappy. No bouncy animations. Everything should feel like pages turning or crisp slides.
motion.disposition_action: When a BDE clicks 'Contacted', the lead card should shrink slightly (transform: scale(0.98)), fade to 0 opacity over 200ms, and collapse its height to 0 to smoothly pull the next lead up into focus.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the near-black text on off-white backgrounds meets AAA standards. Electric Lime text MUST only be used on dark/black backgrounds for legibility, or as thick borders/icons on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a 2px solid #CCFF00 outline on :focus-visible.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack_enforcement: Build the layouts and components using PURE HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript. DO NOT use React, Vue, Tailwind, or Shadcn. The project is an existing Laravel Blade + Vanilla JS SPA.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling_approach: Create a scoped CSS file or style block utilizing semantic class names (e.g., .crm-board, .crm-card, .btn-pill, .stat-hero). Use CSS Grid for the layouts. Use CSS variables for the color palette defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.interactivity: Implement the 'Wow Factors' using vanilla JS DOM manipulation (e.g., adding/removing 'is-active' classes, handling click events for the disposition buttons to animate their removal from the DOM).
instructions_to_main_agent.empty_states: Design beautiful empty states for the BDE Work Stack ('Queue Clear - Excellent Work') using large, light Manrope typography and a subtle Olive-tinted icon.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly adhere to the established editorial-minimal design system. NO glassmorphism, NO heavy dropshadows, NO gradients.
The background of the body/main container MUST be #F5F5F2.
Cards MUST be flat white (#FFFFFF) with an 18px border-radius and a very subtle 1px border (#E5E5E0) rather than a shadow.
Typography MUST be Manrope. Use extreme weight contrast: very light weights for massive numbers, extra bold for small titles.
The Electric Lime color (#CCFF00) is your precision scalpel. Use it ONLY to draw the eye to the single most important action or urgent alert on the screen.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="bde-disposition-contacted-btn"`, `data-testid="bdm-pipeline-column-stage-1"`).
